title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland — Chapter V utterances fixture
description: Schema for the demo caption-room utterance fixture derived from Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, Chapter V (Project Gutenberg eBook #11, public domain). Describes the timed, per-speaker spoken lines used to simulate live captioning in the demo room.

source.description: Attribution and provenance information for the source text.

chapter.description: Chapter title/label the utterances are drawn from.

attribution.description: Attribution statement for the source text.

note.description: Additional notes about how the fixture text was extracted or is intended to be used.

timing.description: Parameters used to derive/simulate the timing of utterances and caption progress.

wordsPerSecond.description: Assumed speaking rate in words per second used to compute utterance durations.

gapWithinTurnSeconds.description: Gap in seconds inserted between consecutive utterances from the same speaker's turn.

gapBetweenTurnsSeconds.description: Gap in seconds inserted between utterances when the speaker changes.

progressEmittedAtFractionOfDuration.description: Fraction of an utterance's duration at which an in-progress caption update (progresstxt) is emitted.

speakers.description: List of distinct speakers appearing in the utterances.

loop.description: Whether the demo playback should loop back to the start after the last utterance.

totalDurationSeconds.description: Total duration in seconds of the full utterance sequence.

utteranceCount.description: Total number of utterances in the utterances array.

utterances.description: Ordered list of timed spoken lines used to drive the demo caption playback.

items.description: A single timed utterance spoken by one of the enumerated speakers.

start.description: Start time in seconds, relative to the beginning of playback.

end.description: End time in seconds, relative to the beginning of playback.

spoken.description: The full spoken line of dialogue.

progresstxt.description: Partial/in-progress text emitted mid-utterance to simulate live captioning; may be empty for very short utterances.
